text_block_list.text: I... I've lost... This can't be!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities this world holds are<n>far more
abundant than my own!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, things are really starting to get<n>interesting
now. I can't wait to come<n>up with new ways to
seize victory<n>from here on out!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you're not feeling down.
Let's go over your race right away, then.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern, but<n>there's no need to
fret!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll never lose hope, no matter what!<n>And I'll never,
ever give up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I promise that in my next race, I'll<n>become the
brightest pearl of all!
